decisions.reason: A consumer superfood drink sits furthest from the firm's engineering and waste-conversion knowledge, so the firm is least able to read its market results and improve it, and its resources are better used in the core technology ventures.
The modular plant extensions build directly on the firm's waste-to-energy engineering and in-house prototyping, so the firm can learn from deployments and keep refining them.
The waste oil plant was promoted with a dedicated launch and uses the firm's own conversion know-how and research cooperations, which favours continued development.
The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant gained its own page by 2019 and fits the firm's core research and engineering base, making it a strategic product the firm is well placed to improve.
